The combination of declining liquidity, increasing cost of goods sold, and a substantial loss in net income creates a very concerning financial picture. While revenue has grown, it isn't enough to offset the increased costs and negative bottom line. The negative net income significantly drags the sentiment score down. However, further investigation into the reasons behind the drastic net income decline is warranted.
